title: FOOTBALL | Kelley Jones Press Conference - 11/22/26
text: You're a guy that uh grew up in Mississippi obviously and recruited by both State and Old Miss. You chose State and then stayed the course and chance to go up there and play in the Egg Bowl. What are your thoughts about the rivalry and you know, how do you feel about Mississippi State and Old Miss? >> I feel like it's a great rivalry, one of the best rivalries ever. Uh I feel like it's a great thing for the program to bring the um the trophy back to uh Star. It was here when I first got here my fresh my freshman year was here and we just trying to do everything, you know, that we can to get it back. Uh great great group of guys over there. You know, we got a great group of guys and you know, made the best win. But it means more cuz you know, I chose Mississippi State and it just it just hit different. >> Mississippi State, pardon me, Miss Obviously the past defense is going to be hard to defend with Trinidad Chamblas, but what do you feel like it's going to take for just you guys as a team to be able to limit them from doing what they're able to usually do? And what is it going to take from an individual perspective? >> Uh just winning out oneonone. uh knowing that every uh given moment that they can make plays. Us just being body on body being all over our guys. Uh giving oursel a great chance to deflect the ball and intercept the ball to give it back to our offense um to get them a chance to go score and win the game. Us just being all day in just doing everything our coach tend to do and just you know praying for the best. >> Kelly, one of the things interesting about the the Egg Bowl rivalry is most of the time the the guys playing out on the field, they've known each other for years. You got some friends on the other side. Do you have a guy on the miss roster that you're friends with? >> Yeah. Uh I I I know one guy. So uh it's two actually. Uh one of them grew up with me. Um Patrick Broomfield. He's a quarterback. He from Claude, Mississippi. And Cintarian Perkins. Um I've been knowing him since like the Mississippi Alabama game. So it's been a long friendship, long friendship uh with the net. You know, Aiden, I know Aiden Williams as well, but he on our side now. So yeah, I know son Tyrion Perkins. It gonna be fun for sure. >> Kelly, going up on Friday, you're most likely going to be matched up against Duce Alexander. Just what does he bring to the table as a wide receiver? And you know, I see the smile already on your face. What is it? How exciting are how excited are you to play against him? >> No, it's really exciting. I just talked to him on the phone like, you know, a couple days ago telling him, you know, like that we coming and he telling me the same thing. You know what I'm saying? It's going to be fun at the end of day. You know, we still guys that love each other and all. He's a very great receiver. You know what I'm saying? He get out his brace very well. But, you know, I'm a guy as well. So, it's a fun thing for me. And, you know, may the best be the best. But, um, we going to see each other when we come out there and line up. You know, it's going to be fun to watch. We both got number one. Only one of us can make it out. So, you know, it's a good thing >> postgame. Uh, you know, could be your last game ever played at Davis Stadium and and you kind of went to your crowd there that has been so loyal to you in a student section. What was that moment like? >> I don't know. It was surreal moment for real. Uh, a moment that I feel I never get back. Um, just knowing that, you know, it might be my last time at Davis Wade, you know, and just being thankful, able to have them people that had the same person. Reese's Parker just to be in that same spot. He always be in each and every game since Arizona State game. Even he came to the the bowl game in North Carolina. So, you know, it just hit different. It feel different for me at that moment. I just feel like, you know, if I could have cried, I would have. But, you know, just being in the moment and just, you know, I go home and just sit sit back and think about it just like, you know, people don't get stuff like that very often. And I'm just very thankful and grateful even have somebody like that showing up and showing that much love. So, you know, it's big for me. >> Kelly, you obviously are Mississippi born and bred. Just what are your favorite memories growing up watching the Egg Bowl and I guess what do you you know cherish most about this rivalry? >> Uh that no matter what your record is, anybody can be beat. Uh that's one of the biggest thing that stood out to me that uh at every snap, every inch matter, everything matter, mistakes matter, everything just matter in that game and it just means more than just hit different. So for us, you know, we waking up with edge on our shoulder that, you know, with the thing that happened this season, you know, things happen, but we can all we all can make it right. We just go win the air ball. So, you know, it'll hit different bring trophy back and give everybody to smile. Give everybody something to smile about. So, it's a good thing. >> Kelly, have you sense a sense of intensity that's more than usual going up in a game rivalry like this? >> Yeah. Uh, we know those guys, you know, ready and they amped up, you know what I'm saying, to come out with their crowd and everybody they got, you know, they got Trinidad And you know, unfortunately, we got some players that's out, but you know, it's no it's no excuses within the game. You know what I'm saying? We got great guys. You know, like I told the other guys, you know what I'm saying? This man up, step up. You know what I'm saying? It's no excuses. We go out there to do what we got to do and we'll come out on top. You know, we'll be able to do tomorrow celebration after the game. So, it is the plan. >> Steve James, >> speaking of talking to the other guys, you are a Mississippi guy that kind of grew up with this. I mean, you you know, if you lose this game, it's going to be your mom that has to go to the grocery store and get clowned on by the the Old Miss moms, right? So, how do you articulate that to perhaps the the transfers and newcomers to explain the intensity of this rivalry? >> Uh, we try to explain as much as we can, but we just know like, you know, they never been, so they really won't get the feeling until they get in there, until they get in the game and see how it really is. And they'll just know like by the look on our eye that just, you know, these means want to just hit different and that we need this by any means. And I feel like they'll get the sense of they feel intense throughout the week that like, you know, like we got guys like Jordan Gilbert, you know, Marcus Williams. It's just a lot of guys that transfer here and we just tell them like, you know what I'm saying, this one the biggest game in history. So, you know, it just hit different and I feel like they got they on the right page. They uh they know what's at stake and they know that um we just trying to come out on top and bring the trophy back and had a fans. I'm happy about >> walk me through what it's like to play in coverage against Trinidad Chamblas and what do you feel like you learned from last year's contest that you can try and apply to this year? uh that he's a great he's a great passer. You can't really give him too much time to throw the ball because if you sit back there and let him get time and just, you know, like dial up the defense, then it it can be a problem. Very great guy. Got a great sense of humor. I feel like he's a very great player. I feel like he's the best player on their team to be honest. If we should be worried about anybody, it should be him. Uh you know, getting him off his square, you know, just doing the stuff we do and hopefully I can uh you know, pick him off. That's the plan. You talk about, you know, loving to do the homework on the guys that you're going up against. How would you describe, you know, Deuce and some of the other Old Miss receivers you're going to be going against? >> Oh, they got a lot of great receiver. They got a tight end as well that he can go out and play receiver. Um, but Duce Alexander the guy that stand out to me the most. He can catch the ball and get vertical real quick. He got um great routes in and out of his breaks. You know what I'm saying? He just he just he's just a different guy. And I just know for me I'm different myself and I go out at him last year and you know it was a great thing to go up against him and things like that. But you know it's a whole new year know that matter last year and I'm just trying to come out and do it and be the one that um win on top. So he know what's at state and I know it's at state. So it really ain't nothing else to talk about until I see him on Friday. So that's the whole plan just doing my job being body on body doing everything my coach telling me to do. Sam >> and you mentioned that you talked to Deuce maybe last week I think you said. What is your connection to him or how do you guys know each other? >> Uh uh I met him in the Egg Bowl last year actually. We was talking to each other know just like within the game just like you know what I'm saying like he was trolling me telling me like I should come to miss and I was like no I ain't come to miss but you know it's just a little thing just play do just play around with each other and um ever since then I met him like over the summer seeing him places you know we just always gather with each other just say hey spoke and talked about the thing that we want to achieve in the season within that and you know we just uh we spoke to each other on the phone and I asked him you know is he going to be ready he asked me the same thing and we just said you know what I'm saying we going to be we going to be at each until after the game. So, it's no talk. You know, if I see him before the game, you know, it's no smiles and no none of that. You feel me? You know how they go with a rival. So, you know, we're just ready to do it Friday. >> Have you had any time to just review yesterday's game yet and what maybe stood out about how you guys played defensively against Tennessee Tech? >> Uh, I feel like we could have did a lot of things better. I just feel like, uh, you know, the intensity of the game. Uh, I feel like we could have got put ourselves in better situation to make plays on the ball. You know, things going to happen within the game, but I just feel like as a whole defense, we got the job done. We won the game, and I feel like that's all that matter. >> I know you probably be matched up with Deuce, but they got another receiver named Caleb Cunningham. Hadn't had as many reps, but he's from right down the road, Arian. Just great athlete. Just Have you looked at him at all on tape? >> Yeah, uh, I watched him on he made a lot of great play. He made a play against Auburn. He's a very big guy. I don't know how tall he is. I think he like 6'2 or 63. I think he's tall enough. But I love great receivers. I love guys who feel like they can, you know, go go and make theel one of the best. And I consider uh myself as well. But I feel like, you know what I'm saying? If he come out there, then you know, we ain't got no choice but to see each other. So, and I feel like, you know, it's kind of like DB and receiver thing. You know, somebody got to win. And I'm just trying to I know he want to win. I know I'm trying to win. So, no matter who come out there, either he come out there or, you know, dudes come out there or the And no matter who come out there, you know, I'm just trying to win my one-on-one, do everything my coach tell me to do. So, it's going to be fun to see cuz he from Mississippi and I'm from Mississippi and we'll be finally u we'll finally meet each other. >> Anything else? All right. Thank you guys. >> Thank y'all. Thank y'all so much.
